- Frontload credit: 6% of the first-year committed value applied as a service credit over first 90 days (or one-time invoice credit)

Hannah — thanks for the write-up and the forecast. I'm ok to move forward with a concession but want to tighten a few items before we present a final term sheet to the customer: 

1) Frontload credit: reduce to 4% of first-year committed value and structure as a distributed service credit applied pro-rata over first 90 days. This controls revenue impact while still helping their Q1.
2) Term discount: target 15% final (we should present 18% as a 'best & final' if necessary, but book at 15% for finance).
3) Swingline: $50k cap is fine operationally; require a 30-day settlement plus a hard cap on consecutive draws (max two consecutive months) to prevent running credit facility.
4) SLA: include a 2% service credit if availability < 99.5% (to be documented in SOW).
5) Contractual: add a clawback clause for the frontload credit in the event of early termination or if actual usage < 60% of committed ARR in the first 12 months.

If Kimberly confirms that the accounting team can accept the distributed credit treatment, I'm good to approve. Route to Legal for the clawback language and then we can get Hannah to issue a signed term sheet & DocuSign.
